name: Asset
description: Library for reading assets of all types from the filesystem.

functions.name: loadModel
description: Loads a 3D model at the given path from the virtual filesystem.
The given path should not contain a file extension, as this is determined automatically from a list of supported formats:

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the model in the VFS, minus an extension.

functions.name: loadMap
description: Loads a map at the given path from the virtual filesystem.
The given path should not contain a file extension, as this is determined automatically from a list of supported formats:

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the map in the VFS, minus an extension.

classes.name: Asset3dRigidBody
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing the physics motion of a node.

properties.name: isStatic
properties.description: Whether this rigid-body is static (generates collisions but cannot move).

classes.name: Asset3dNode
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` which can be considered 1:1 with TASBox entities.

properties.name: isRoot
properties.description: Whether this node is at the root of the hierarchy (i.e. has no parent).

properties.name: shouldPrune
properties.description: Whether this node should be discarded when loading (i.e. should not create an entity).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Optional display name for the entity.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Indices of this node's children in the asset's `nodes` array.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Position of this node relative to its parent.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Orientation of this node relative to its parent.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: Scale of this node relative to its parent.

properties.name: rigidBody
properties.description: Optional rigid-body motion for this node.

properties.name: colliderIndex
properties.description: Optional index of a physics collider to attach to this node.

properties.name: meshIndex
properties.description: Optional index of a mesh to attach to this node.

properties.name: skeletonIndex
properties.description: Optional index of a skeleton to attach to this node.

classes.name: Asset3dInverseBindPose
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing the inverse bind pose of a bone.

classes.name: Asset3dBone
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing the bone of a skeleton.

properties.name: nodeIndex
properties.description: Index of the bone's node in the asset's node array.

properties.name: inverseBindPose
properties.description: Inverse bind pose of the bone used for pre-transforming the mesh during skinning.

classes.name: Asset3dSkeleton
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` listing nodes to use as bone positions for skinned meshes.

properties.name: bones
properties.description: List of bones which skinned meshes that reference this skeleton index into.

classes.name: Asset3dArticulationLimit
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing a limit on a single degree of freedom of an articulation link's constraint.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum rotation about this degree of freedom in radians.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum rotation about this degree of freedom in radians.

properties.name: isFixed
properties.description: Whether the limit is fixed (min and max are within a small tolerance).

classes.name: Asset3dArticulationLimits
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing the limits of an articulation link's constraint.

properties.name: angularX
properties.description: Limit on rotation about the joint's local X axis (in radians).

properties.name: angularY
properties.description: Limit on rotation about the joint's local Y axis (in radians).

properties.name: angularZ
properties.description: Limit on rotation about the joint's local Z axis (in radians).

properties.name: jointType
properties.description: Joint type with the minimum number of degrees of freedom for these limits.

classes.name: Asset3dArticulationConstraint
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing the constraint formed by an articulation link.

properties.name: limits
properties.description: Limits of the constraint about each degree of freedom.

classes.name: Asset3dArticulationLink
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing a link between two nodes in an articulation.

properties.name: parentNodeIndex
properties.description: Index of the link's parent in the asset's node array.

properties.name: childNodeIndex
properties.description: Index of the link's child in the asset's node array.

properties.name: constraint
properties.description: Details about the constraint between the parent and child nodes.

classes.name: Asset3dArticulation
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing a physics reduced coordinate articulation.

properties.name: rootNodeIndex
properties.description: Index of the articulation root in the asset's node array.

properties.name: links
properties.description: Links between nodes in the articulation.

classes.name: Asset3dCollider
classes.description: Internal structure of `Asset3d` describing a geometry with mass properties.

classes.name: Asset3d
classes.description: A 3D model or prefab containing materials, meshes, physics objects and more. Roughly follows the glTF structure.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: Primary structure of the asset, defining a hierarchy of nodes (which can be considered 1:1 with entities).

properties.name: skeletons
properties.description: Visual skeletons referenced by skinned mesh nodes.

properties.name: articulations
properties.description: Physics articulations joining nodes together into a single reduced coordinate system for simulation stability.

properties.name: colliders
properties.description: Physics colliders comprised of geometry and mass properties.

properties.name: meshes
properties.description: Visual meshes referenced by nodes.

properties.name: materials
properties.description: Visual materials referenced by meshes.

classes.name: MapEntity
classes.description: Internal structure of `Map` representing properties of an entity to spawn.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Position of the entity in world space.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Orientation of the entity in world space.

properties.name: asset
properties.description: Optional asset to spawn at the entity's position and orientation.

properties.name: entities
properties.description: List of entities in the map.
